long_biography.plain_text:
Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio began inside the optical retailer Salmoiraghi & Viganò, becoming chief executive after joining the family enterprise. Later appointments placed him at the centre of brand direction and corporate planning, including the Italian eyewear group's board chair. These duties belong to the younger Del Vecchio: Luxottica's creation and growth were achievements of his father, Leonardo.

When the elder Del Vecchio died in 2022, ownership of the Luxembourg holding company passed equally to eight beneficiaries. Leonardo Maria's resulting 12.5% interest links most of his fortune to EssilorLuxottica, while Delfin also holds major banking, insurance and property positions. He established LMDV Capital as a distinct vehicle for acquisitions and fund allocations spanning hospitality, food and beverage, healthcare, technology and publishing. He now chairs that vehicle, with day-to-day authority assigned to its chief executive.
